data.narrative: Executed end-to-end integration and verification capstone for SkillSwap platform. Audit contract boundaries, performed incremental merge of 3 workstreams, verified user flow scenarios, built requirements traceability matrix, and resolved status enum contract mismatch bug.

dimension_scores.observation: Constructed complete requirements traceability matrix mapping Module 1 requirements through implementation and test locations.
Executed incremental workstream integration ordering from core directory to auth to booking delegation.
Mitigated integration failure risks through pre-integration contract audits and scenario-based flow verification.
Created repeatable 3-scenario integration test plan with explicit pre-conditions, steps, and expected outcomes.
Demonstrated mastery of mid-build adaptation and contract drift resolution throughout capstone.
Traced and resolved subtle status enum contract mismatch ('confirmed' vs 'active') between Booking Service and Provider Dashboard.

strengths: Demonstrated capstone mastery across all 6 decomposition and execution planning dimensions
Identified and resolved cross-component contract enum mismatch with zero system regression
data.recommendation: Advance to Skill #5 Production Readiness or Skill #6 Technical Communication.
